The dev's read-only measurement on `origin/main` `5fa9375e` (copy at the seat's project folder, `server-seat4/30117-measure.md`) falsifies the dispatch assumption that an existing action-param type can draw the picker:

- `sys-user.object.ts:365` `permissionSet` is an inline `type: 'text'` param.
- The grant column `sys_user_permission_set.permission_set` is `Field.text` with `widget: 'permission-ref'` (stores the name, ADR-0131 D4); there is no `sys_permission_set` object on `main`.
- No existing param type draws this picker: `ActionParamSchema` has no `widget` key; the console's `resolveActionParams` copies no field widget onto a param (a field-bound param is still a text box, and it refuses the whole dialog when plugin-security metadata is not loaded, which is why #25338 inlined it); `paramValueShape.ts:181` states `permission-ref` is "a widget hint only, not declarable as a param type"; `lookup` stores a record id, which the grant refuses; `select` takes static options only, with no server-filled precedent.
- So the card's "Expected" needs a **spec** change (a `widget` on `ActionParamSchema`, or `permission-ref` as a param type: a widening of a published contract) and a **ui** change (`resolveActionParams` / `paramToField` pass-through). The one-line server switch follows them.
- The refusal text: its prefix is built in `plugin-auth` `admin-user-endpoints.ts:1049`; its inner sentence in `plugin-security` `grant-permission-set-name.ts:115` is shared by every non-system grant write (Setup's grant form included).

Asking triage (`pm:retriage`): split into a spec slice (the param widget / type), a ui slice (the ui lane is paused), and the server one-liner `Blocked-by` both; and say whether the refusal sentence (shared by every grant path) is a separate card. This seat does not re-claim until the split lands.

## Note for this card's PR · 2026-11-05T15:49Z · two lines PR #30543 leaves for it

PR #30543 (#30260) makes `widget` on an action param live: the action dialog draws the named widget (`widget: 'permission-ref'` on a `text` param is the permission-set picker). This card is its first producer, so two things become this card's PR's to carry when it adds `widget: 'permission-ref'` to Create User's inline `permissionSet` param:

1. **Retire the stale comment** at `packages/platform-objects/src/identity/sys-user.object.ts` (about line 359, `origin/main`): "its picker is a widget hint params do not inherit" stops being true once the param names the widget itself.
2. **Studio's action preview** draws that param as a text box while the dialog draws the picker: `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/previews/ActionPreview.tsx` `runtimeWidgetFor` builds its answer from `type` and `reference` only. Pass `widget` through and answer the key the dialog draws (`authoredWidgetKey(param) ?? resolveParamWidgetType(type)`, the same expression `paramToField` uses), so "what will render" matches. Named as a follow-up in the delta contract review 6662404259 on PR #30543, ④ (e). Today no action param authors `widget`, so nothing reaches the mismatch until this card lands; that is why it rides here and is not a card of its own.

The second line is `ui/**`: if this card's PR stays server-only, ping the `domain:ui` seats and the preview line goes out as a ui card then.
